notes:
Account summary:
- Mid-market product analytics SaaS. Product org (20 engs on ML/platform teams) evaluating Redwood for chat & knowledge features; migrating from a mix of in-house LLM proxies + OpenAI for spikes.
- Started Hosted API trial 2024-11-10 (self-serve onboarding). AE Jordan intro call 11/12, demo with SE Priya 11/20 (Fireflies: ff_8b2c9a34-vertoflux-demo-2024-11-20).
Hosted API trial observations (prod-shadowing + staged traffic):
- 3-week trial window; baseline traffic reproducer attached in Drive.
- Observed avg QPS (chat endpoints): 6.2 QPS during business hours, peak 12 QPS (short burst 17 QPS).
- Concurrency (in-flight tokens): avg 4.5, peak sustained concurrency 9 for 10m windows.
- Token mix: 68% short chat exchanges (~60-120 tokens / request), 22% medium summarization (300-600 tokens), 10% long-report generation (700-1500 tokens).
- Weighted avg tokens/request ~210; avg tokens/sec at peak ~2520 (12 QPS * 210).
- Latency SLO target: 95th <= 280ms for chat; trial saw 95th ~320ms under peak when using batching=auto; retriable fallback to smaller model kept tail from exploding.
Business requirements & priorities:
- Primary: responsive in-app chat (low-latency), secondary: nightly embedding pipeline (~50k vectors/day), tertiary: on-demand longer summaries for account managers.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market procurement; looking to cap per-token spend and prefer predictable monthly committed spend (Dedicated interest).
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS keywrap, audit-log export (90 days) and VPC peering for Private control plane. SOC2 certificate required for procurement stage.
Dedicated sizing & forecasting ask (what they want from Redwood):
- Runbook for capacity sizing based on observed trial metrics (QPS/concurrency/token mix). Prefer both low-latency pod sizing (for chat) and batch pod recommendation (for embeddings and long summaries).
- Example ask: "Give us a config that maintains 95th < 250ms at 12 QPS with our token mix, plus a plan for 2x and 4x growth scenarios."
- They asked for explicit GPU/node recommendations (e.g., nRTX8000 or A100 equiv), target concurrency per node, expected tokens/sec per node, expected cost per month at committed 300k tokens/day.
POC milestones & timeline:
- 11/20: SE demo + hosted trial kickoff.
- 12/01: Mid-trial sync — trial metrics reviewed; flagged latency under peak. Action: SE suggested KV prefix caching and aggressive batching tuning for non-chat paths. (Drive: Redwood_Dedicated_Pricing_v1.xlsx)
- 12/05: Engineering deep-dive w/ Redwood runtime team. Discussed kernel selection, quantization profiles. SE note: recommend q4-bit quantization for long summaries (>512 tokens) to reduce memory pressure.
- 12/08: Pricing discussion with procurement (finance present). They want 12-month committed quote for Dedicated with optional burst capacity.
- Next: Redwood to deliver Dedicated sizing proposal + cost model by 2024-12-18. Customer legal to review SOC2 addendum in parallel.
